references.purpose: four-direction grounded workstation layout only; rejected as scholar workstation

prompt: Create one Realm strategy-game SCHOLAR WORKSTATION component board: a compact, grounded wooden cartographer's lectern with a sloped open parchment atlas, one brass divider/compass, two pinned map corners, a small lower shelf with rolled charts, and a clearly visible floor-contact plinth. Use the attached ale-cask stand only for four-direction workstation layout, scale, painterly raster treatment, warm upper-left lighting, and chroma-key setup; do not reuse tavern shapes. One large board containing four independently authored directional lecterns for front/down, rear/up, left, and right, spaced far apart. Each direction must have an obvious stable base and remain readable when reduced to roughly 28x25 pixels; parchment should be pale, wood dark walnut, brass accents sparse. Every workstation fully visible and uncropped. Perfect flat solid #ff00ff background; no person, hands, quill, floating book, room, floor, labels, borders, text, UI, shadows beyond object-local shading, duplicate fragments, or watermark.
